mapper.sql: id, name, key_hash, key_prefix, expires_at, token_quota, request_quota, tokens_used, requests_used, is_active, created_at, last_used_at, hit_count, key_plain
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_key (name, key_hash, key_prefix, expires_at, token_quota, request_quota, tokens_used, requests_used, is_active, created_at, last_used_at, hit_count, key_plain) VALUES (#{name}, #{keyHash}, #{keyPrefix}, #{expiresAt}, #{tokenQuota}, #{requestQuota}, #{tokensUsed}, #{requestsUsed}, #{isActive}, #{createdAt}, #{lastUsedAt}, #{hitCount}, #{keyPlain})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM api_key ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE api_key SET name = #{name}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, token_quota = #{tokenQuota}, request_quota = #{requestQuota}, is_active = #{isActive} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE api_key SET tokens_used = tokens_used + #{tokensDelta}, requests_used = requests_used + 1, last_used_at = #{at}, hit_count = hit_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
